about.title: about our company
about.description: We are a company specialized in technical drilling services for high-demand projects. We operate under the strictest international standards of safety, efficiency and quality control. Our commitment is centered on four fundamental pillars: rigorous compliance with delivery deadlines, optimization of our clients' operational costs, delivery of highly reliable geological information, and the development of operations that prioritize safety and environmental sustainability.

valueProposition.title: Value proposition
valueProposition.subtitle: We focus on generating real impact on your operations through three fundamental pillars.

items.title: Reduce internal costs
items.text: We take over drilling management to minimize your operational costs and enhance your geological resources.

items.title: Reduce drilling costs
items.text: We implement and develop improvements to reduce operational costs and increase productivity and quality.

items.title: Optimize drilling projects
items.text: Drilling projects will be stable and efficient in the short and medium term.

items.title: Diamond Drilling
items.text: Rock core extraction on surface and underground mining with millimetric precision.

items.title: Grouting Drilling
items.text: Cement and grout injection for ground stabilization and leak sealing.

items.title: RC Drilling
items.text: Reverse circulation for fast and efficient mining exploration with continuous sampling.

items.title: WW Drilling
items.text: Water well construction with state-of-the-art equipment, ensuring efficiency and performance.

items.title: Geotechnical & Hydrogeological Drilling
items.text: Soil and groundwater investigation for engineering projects.

items.title: Geological Services
items.text: Mapping, sampling and field geological analysis for exploration and deposit evaluation.
